description: The Mukesh Ambani-led company said it will build a fully modular, future-ready AI data centre, which will host world’s most advanced GPUs, TPUs and AI processors
body_lead: Reliance Industries and the Andhra Pradesh government on November 14 signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to set up a 1 GW artificial intelligence data centre as it seeks to cement its long-standing partnership amid a new wave of investments in the state, a company statement said. The understanding was inked in the presence of chief minister Chandrababu Naidu, IT minister Nara Lokesh and Reliance executive director PMS Prasad, the statement said.
